name: Rock-Hewn Churches, Lalibela
description: Carved downward into solid volcanic rock in the Ethiopian Highlands, Lalibela's eleven medieval churches stand in deep trenches, each shaped from a single block of stone. King Lalibela commissioned them around 800 years ago to create a "New Jerusalem," reportedly in about 24 years. They are still active places of worship, and pilgrims gather here in large numbers.
